title: Chapter 218: Destroy All The Ghouls In One Battle
content:
Chapter 218: Destroy All The Ghouls In One Battle

The war in the underground world has spread from a corner of the original ghoul clan territory to the middle of the ghoul clan territory. If it goes a little further, it will reach the core area of the ghoul clan territory.

In the core area of the ghoul clan territory, there are densely packed skeleton blood pools, some of which are huge skeleton blood pools.

The ghouls guarding the core area are very strong, and the Zerg finally encountered star-level ghouls here.

The two clans have been fighting for so long, and the ghoul clan has only sent out ordinary ghouls and some giant ghouls. Their truly powerful ghouls are all gathered in the core area of the territory.

A large number of giant ghouls are distributed in various parts of the core area, among which there are many star-level giant ghouls with stronger range and power. It is precisely because of the protection of such a large number of giant ghouls that the Zerg's flying dragon group has never attacked this core area.

When the liquid fireball of the Zerg Destroyer with a long range fell into the core area of the ghouls' territory, it was like poking a hornet's nest. Countless one-star ghouls rushed out from the core area and rushed towards the long snake formation of the Zerg army.

The troops in the middle of the long snake formation of the Zerg army were originally enough to deal with the impact of ordinary ghouls, but now they suddenly became exhausted.

The defense ability and charging speed of one-star ghouls have been greatly improved, which makes the firepower of the Zerg cockroaches and hydralisks in the frontal combat somewhat insufficient.

The fastest Zerg flying dragons quickly gathered in the middle and suppressed the one-star ghouls with high-speed charging in the air.

Five thousand Zerg stealth spiders all quickly crawled towards the middle area. They drilled into the ground to provide long-range underground firepower support.

The Zerg destroyers, who were originally attacking in a scattered manner, also set their attack targets on the charging one-star ghouls.

A group of Zerg explosive mosquitoes hovered in the air, watching closely, just in case.

In a very short period of time, the one-star ghouls attacked by various arms of the Zerg army could not withstand such fierce multi-level and all-round firepower coverage, and suffered heavy casualties. Their fierce momentum was interrupted.

The one-star ghouls lost the continuity of the charge, and the threat to the Zerg army's front line, which had been strengthened multiple times, was rapidly reduced. Without the suddenness at the beginning, it was impossible for them to break through the Zerg army's firepower network.

The giant ghouls in the core area of the ghoul clan's territory, no matter how many stars they were, their range could not reach the Zerg army.

After the Zerg army stabilized the front line, the Zerg destroyers began to focus on the giant ghouls within the range.

After the strength is improved, the giant ghouls are larger and have strong defense capabilities. The killing effect of ordinary Zerg destroyers begins to decline.

The war is going on, and the system's resources are rapidly coming in. Wu Qing evolves and upgrades 5,000 Zerg destroyers to one-star level on the battlefield, increasing the number of one-star Zerg destroyers to 10,000.

Ten thousand one-star Zerg destroyers, together with a small number of two-star and three-star Zerg destroyers, have formed an absolute suppression of the giant ghouls in the core area of the ghoul clan's territory.

These giant ghouls with star-level strength look very scary. If they are allowed to attack the Zerg army, they will definitely cause a lot of unnecessary losses.

If the Zerg army wants to move forward, it must kill these giant ghouls first.

This ghoul clan is just restrained by the Zerg. If they are released, the original Naga clan, Tengu clan, demon clan and bear goblin clan in this area where the Zerg is located will not be able to beat this ghoul clan.

The giant ghouls of the ghoul clan are a very scary long-range soldier. Their range is longer than that of the flame demons, and the amount of corrosive mucus they spray is particularly large. Few creatures can survive their attacks.

Coupled with their strong defensive capabilities, the comprehensive capabilities of the giant ghouls are stronger than many long-range soldiers.

Unfortunately, they encountered stronger Zergs, and the giant ghouls basically did not play a role.

Before the Zerg destroyers appeared, they could still fight. Once the Zerg destroyers appeared, the slow-moving giant ghouls became decorations and live targets. As long as they appeared on the battlefield, they would be eliminated first.

The ghoul clan found that the star ghouls in the core area still could not break through the Zerg front line, so they concentrated all the ghouls in the territory to the core area to fight to the death with the Zerg in the core area.

The reinforcements of the Ghoul Clan, the Evil Eye and the Underground Ratman, had already withdrawn. The Ghoul Clan seemed to be able to find only these two races willing to help. The two races were severely beaten by the Zerg and left in disgrace.

The war has continued until now, and no new reinforcements have appeared. The Ghoul Clan can only fight alone.

The Ghoul Clan's troops are moving to the core area, and the Zerg army's front line is also moving to the middle position, concentrating more troops near the core area of the Ghoul Clan's territory.

The huge number of Zerg puppies that have not participated in the war rushed from both sides of the Zerg army's front line, rushed into the territory that was no longer defended by the Ghouls, and destroyed all traces of the Ghouls.

The Zerg puppies quickly occupied the underground passage where the evil eyes and underground ratmen once appeared, and found that the underground passage had been buried and destroyed. It was necessary to dig it up again to see whether it was a normal passage leading to the underground or a space transmission passage.

In the core area of the ghoul clan's territory, more ghouls rushed out and rushed to the front line of the Zerg army.

Among the ordinary ghouls, there were star-level ghouls. They kept charging and falling down, turning into a beam of light and becoming the energy and gas resources of the system.

The Zerg army organized a full-scale three-dimensional long-range firepower network in the air, on the ground, and underground. Any ordinary army's charge was futile.

It was also extremely difficult to consume the Zerg army with super-endurance and recovery capabilities.

The ghoul clan, which originally had nearly 100 million troops, had less than 10 million troops after so many days of continuous consumption. They all withdrew to the core area of the ghoul clan's territory and guarded the most important place of the ghoul clan with all their strength.

Under the personal command of Wu Qing and the Queen, the Zerg army was not in a hurry to attack the core area of the ghouls' territory. Instead, they fought steadily step by step, closed the front line, adjusted the attack frequency of each type of soldiers, and recovered while fighting to ensure the sustained combat effectiveness of the Zerg army.

The underground world is not affected by the night, so they can continue to fight until the ghouls are completely defeated.

More than 20,000 Zerg destroyers, at a moderate frequency, continuously attacked the core area of the ghouls' territory, forcing the ghouls, who could only passively take the beating, to send troops to attack the Zerg army's front line, so that the Zerg army could calmly eliminate the living forces of the ghouls.

A large number of Zerg puppies were wreaking havoc in other areas of the ghouls' territory, focusing on destroying the skeleton blood pools distributed everywhere.

Those mysterious large pools full of blood and corpses, in which the giant eggs were still hatching ghouls, these skeleton blood pools carried a lot of the ghouls' luck. Every time the Zerg destroyed one, they could get a huge amount of resources.

Nearly one million main forces of the Zerg slowly gathered together, and with the assistance of some Zerg puppies, they fought against the entire tribe of the Ghoul Clan gathered in the core area of the territory.

Countless Zerg puppies swept the entire territory of the Ghoul Clan except the core area like sweeping the floor.

The main force of the Zerg advanced step by step to the core area of the Ghoul Clan's territory. The Zerg destroyers first defeated the giant ghouls, allowing the Zerg army to advance without worries.

Without the threat of enemy long-range troops, the Zerg's various long-range firepower output was fully exerted, bombing, burning, and corroding every inch of land in the core area of the Ghoul Clan's territory.

A large number of skeleton blood pools were destroyed by the Zerg one after another, and countless ghouls rushed desperately and fell on the way to charge.

The more the Zerg army advanced forward, the stronger the strength of the ghouls it faced. The stronger the enemy's strength, the slower the Zerg army advanced forward.

There were constantly powerful ghouls charging in the charging team, which brought certain risks to the Zerg army.

The powerful ghouls used the cover of other ghouls to rush to the front of the Zerg cockroaches and hydralisks several times. Just when they were about to start a killing spree, the Zerg queen's spawning attack came, instantly freezing and killing them.

There were a large number of Zerg hosts monitoring the battlefield, and the enemy could not play any tricks at all.

In this way, the Zerg army slowly advanced forward, and the ghouls desperately blocked the battle. The war lasted for a day and a night.

In the end, the ghouls' troops were exhausted!

Those wise men of the ghouls, who had very strong spiritual power, all left through an underground passage in the core area. They did not die with the ghouls' territory.

Wu Qing suspected that the wise men of the ghouls who evacuated were the real ghouls, and ordinary ghouls and giant ghouls might just be their combat tools.

Now his conjecture cannot be confirmed, and he needs to continue to explore and verify it.

Countless Zerg puppies rushed forward and carried out the final cleanup of the core area of the Ghoul Clan's territory. They destroyed all the skeleton blood pools and eliminated all traces of the Ghoul Clan.

At this moment, the Zerg completed the task of occupying the Ghoul Clan's territory in the underground world, and also gained a real foothold in the underground world.

Outside this territory is the strange wild area of the underground world, which the Zerg has not yet explored.

The underground passage where the Ghoul Clan's wise men finally evacuated was also destroyed and buried. It is not clear whether it is a space transmission passage.
